Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d

Class ToastQueue

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d.ToastQueue
public final class ToastQueue extends Object
The set of notifications currently shown as transient toasts, and when each expires. Distinct from the NotificationModel log: the log keeps every notification for the tray to list, while this queue holds only the handful popping up right now and drops them once their time-to-live elapses.

Time is never read here — every method takes the current time in milliseconds — so expiry and the visible cap are deterministic and unit-testable headless, and the ToastLayer drives them from its repaint timer.
